items.title: Tokenized Stocks Show Real Demand But Remain Volatile and Illiquid, IMF Finds
items.summary: An IMF analysis found that more than half of tokenized stock trading happens outside U.S. market hours, though the roughly $2.3 billion market remains more volatile and less liquid than traditional equities.
items.titleZh: 国际货币基金组织发现，代币化股票显示出实际需求，但仍不稳定且缺乏流动性
items.summaryZh: 国际货币基金组织的一项分析发现，超过一半的代币化股票交易发生在美国市场交易时间之外，尽管大约23亿美元的市场仍然比传统股票更不稳定，流动性更低。

items.title: AI is automating coding. So why are software developer job postings on the rise?
items.summary: Software developer job postings are rebounding, led by senior and AI-focused roles, even as AI automates more coding and entry-level hiring weakens.
items.titleZh: AI正在自动编码。那么，为什么软件开发人员的招聘信息越来越多呢？
items.summaryZh: 软件开发人员的招聘岗位正在反弹，主要是高级和以人工智能为重点的职位，尽管人工智能自动化了更多的编码，入门级招聘减弱了。
